about: Real token counts (tiktoken cl100k_base and o200k_base, measured 2026-10-18) for short samples in several scripts. `estimate` is what protocol/tokens (Rust sdcd/src/tokens.rs and app/src/lib/tokens.ts) must return: the Rust and TypeScript tests both read this file, so the two estimators cannot drift apart, and both assert estimate >= max(cl100k, o200k) (never undercounts).
